author: BmB
body:
Needed for a while now but can i say thank you to all members of this clan, for sticking with me through our hard times and for being great friends and players. Well done guys and thanks so much. <3  

We have been known to be immature and inappropriate but everyone makes mistakes, we are only human. The clan has re-formed and we hope to make amends to anyone we have offended in the past. This is a fresh start so please no prejudice against us. Thank you. Without further ado here we are. 

Hello and welcome to Bad Company. We are a fun loving and 1337 clan. We consider ourselves one of the best clans/teams on Avicus. We have been around a while now and if you think you are up to the job then please apply. :) We take playing seriously once in a game however we are always up for a laugh. 

 
We are open at the moment! 
 Positions: 

Rusher: It is your job to rush and break the monuments, you can do this stealthily or as a quick sprinting rush! 

Offence: It is your job to get to the enemy's side and hold positions, whilst killing/distracting enemy's. 

Midfield: Your job is to stay on your team's side and to stop any enemy's getting past you, a defensive position.

Defender: You will sit in or next to the monuments and make sure that no one breaks the monuments, you should be experienced in monument defending techniques.

Substitute: You are still a member of this clan if someone on the team cannot attend a scrim or tournament then you will take there place. I think most of you know how subs work in the clan, you play exactly as much as regular members. You just don't start off playing.
———————————————————————————————————————
Owner: bmbrocks321
Co-owner: zeus449

The All Stars 

Rusher: bmbrocks321 (I run dis shit) 
             cels43             (He's a beast, i call him karma.)
            
Offense:  RemyleOuistiti  (Dwarf Cheerleader)
                rot43      (Dun check behind your schoooll..)
         
Midfield:    zeus449 (Bearhug da life outta you)
                 Ronloyd (Block-a-hitta i dare you..)

Defense: cedd2701 (His testicles have been morphed in such a way...)
               zero9178 (YOU SHALL NOT PASS)
          
Substitute:  
                   Thecalined (Defense Sub) Orgaccent bby <3
                   Adrianosborne (Rusher Sub) He's not actually called adrian, plot twissst...)
                   kiwi654321       (Offense Sub) Teehee no one knows who he is.) 
                   Buster_U (Rusher Sub) Princess bearhug.

We need some members you application format should be as following:
Kills: 
K/D Ratio (Must be over 1.5, however exceptions can be made):
Previous Clans:
Skype (Mandatory): 
Teamspeak: 

Spectate list: 
^ Picture above curtesy of TinyNitai! Thank you very much!

I would love to see this clan become successful and an overall good clan that are good but do not take things too seriously.

Thank you BmB!

(Teehee) They said i couldn't have it but i will, testicle crew live on, forever. Rot/Cedd/Bmb. The motto is: Tickle my pickle, make love to a nipple, touch my testis; here in Bad Company we're all besties. >:) 
 
Fanks rot m8.

Children he is coming. 

Don't go behind your school. 

Good luck sleeping. 

Rot's last victim.

Scrim Record! 
17:2:7
